input: owner: drop the static-site-only requirement; apps should be distributable many ways to many platforms
task: Remove the static-site-only/static-first default from the guidance

doc_friction.issue: Section 2 ranked a static site first and allowed a service 'only when the product genuinely cannot be any of the above', a de facto static-only rule the owner called harmful (2026-10-21).
'Prefer a static/browser shape' and 'anything with a process needs a new host decision from the owner' read as a blocker on any non-static product.

notes: Owner asked to drop any static-site-only requirement. No literal rule existed, but the bias lived in PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK §2 (static-first order, service only as last resort), portfolio/hosting/README.md (prefer static; processes need an owner host decision), README.md, portfolio/DIRECTION.md, ventures/CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.md. Recorded the owner's words in prompts/goals.md under 'Direction: every platform' and made §2 a menu (browser app, CLI/library, user's CI, native/desktop/mobile/extension, service run by users or deployers). Kept the cost/liability line: no per-user bill on owner accounts, no unattended paid automation. Docs-only change. CI: changed-ventures failed with 'CLAUDE.md: no such venture' because touchedVentures() in platform/pages/clauses.mjs read ventures/CLAUDE.md as a slug; fixed (require a path inside the venture dir) with a regression test. node --test platform/pages/clauses.test.mjs: 28 pass; node platform/pages/clauses.mjs --changed-since origin/main: exit 0. main landed an equivalent clauses.mjs fix meanwhile; the merge took main's version. main's DIRECTION.md rewrite said 'GitHub Pages is the only host'; reworded in the merge.
